knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Setup

## Load libraries and dataset
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
library(jtools)
library(psych)
library(EFAtools)
library(lavaan)
hsls <- haven::read_dta("hsls_subset.dta")
df <- hsls %>% haven::as_factor()
```

## Subset Parent Questions for pa Year
```{r}
home_involvement <- df %>% dplyr::select(s1momtalkm, s1dadtalkm, s1momtalks, s1dadtalks)

```

# Factor Analysis

```{r}
fit_p1_home <- EFA(home_involvement, 
    n_factors = 1, # two factors
    rotation = "promax", 
    cor_method = "spearman", # b/c Likert
    method = c("PAF", "ML", "ULS"))


# save factor loadings as csv file
fit_p1_home_data <- cbind(fit_p1_home$rot_loadings, fit_p1_home$h2) %>% as.data.frame()
```

## Reliability
```{r}
psych::alpha(phbae)
psych::alpha(psd)

omega(home_involvement, nfactors = 2)

```

#  Poisson Regression
```{r}

poi <- glm(data = df,
  2*x3tcredmat ~ # do this by semester since there are half credits
    phbae_scale + par_exp1 + par_sch_inv + # parent factors
    as.factor(x1race) + frpl + par_ba + female + # ses/demographics
    s1m8 + x1txmtscor + # prior achievement
    x1mtheff + x1mthuti + x1mthint + x1mthid + # affective
    as.factor(x1locale) + x1control, # school level
  family = poisson)

summ(poi, exp = TRUE)

```
#  Linear Regression
```{r}

lm <- lm(data = df,
 scale(x3tcredmat) ~ # do this by semester since there are half credits
    phbae_scale + par_exp1 + par_sch_inv + # parent factors
    as.factor(x1race) + frpl + par_ba + female + # ses/demographics
    s1m8 + x1txmtscor + # prior achievement
    x1mtheff + x1mthuti + x1mthint + x1mthid + # affective
    as.factor(x1locale) + x1control) # school level


summ(lm)

```

# Logistic Regressin
```{r}
glm <- glm(data = df,
 adv_math ~ # do this by semester since there are half credits
    phbae_scale + par_exp1 + par_sch_inv + # parent factors
    as.factor(x1race) + frpl + par_ba + female + # ses/demographics
    s1m8 + x1txmtscor + # prior achievement
    x1mtheff + x1mthuti + x1mthint + x1mthid + # affective
    as.factor(x1locale) + x1control, # school level
 family = binomial)


summ(glm, exp = TRUE)

```
